title: tee -J record
description: One FILE that `tee -J` wrote to, once its input ended (or, with --output-error=exit, once tee stopped). With -J the data goes to the FILEs only, not to standard output. A FILE that could not be opened or written has an error record instead. Error records (`#/$defs/error`) are in the same stream. One record per line (NDJSON); version 1 of the Dogfish record format (doc/ndjson.md). Fields may be added in later releases.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

append.description: Whether the data was appended (-a) rather than replacing what the file held.

error.description: An error record: the structured twin of a diagnostic the tool also printed on standard error, in order with the other records.
The diagnostic as printed on standard error, without the `tool: ` prefix.

path.description: The file the diagnostic names first, as given.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

errno.description: The system error number, when the diagnostic ends with its message (2 for `No such file or directory`).
